The [[2024 Indian general election]] was held in Telangana on 13 May 2024 to elect 17 members of the [[18th Lok Sabha]].<ref>{{cite news|url = https://www.livemint.com/news/india/rahul-gandhi-reveals-congresss-plan-to-decimate-bjp-in-lok-sabha-polls-2024-next-is-telangana-11685861494563.html|title =Rahul Gandhi reveals Congress's plan to 'decimate' BJP in Lok Sabha polls 2024, 'Next is Telangana…'|access-date=2023-06-23}}</ref><ref>{{cite news|url = https://zeenews.india.com/india/congress-will-win-both-in-telangana-2024-lok-sabha-elections-says-v-hanumantha-rao-2621437.html|title =Congress Will Win Both In Telangana, 2024 Lok Sabha Elections, Says V Hanumantha Rao|access-date=2023-06-23}}</ref><ref>{{cite news|url = https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/city/hyderabad/no-pre-poll-alliance-with-any-party-in-2024-elections-telangana-minister-kt-rama-rao/articleshow/99596684.cms|title =No pre-poll alliance with any party in 2024 elections: Telangana minister KT Rama Rao|access-date=2023-06-23}}</ref><ref>{{cite news|url = https://www.thehindu.com/news/national/telangana/all-polling-stations-in-telangana-to-have-new-evms-for-upcoming-state-elections-and-2024-ls-polls/article66842341.ece|title =All polling stations in Telangana to have new EVMs for upcoming State elections and 2024 LS polls|access-date=2023-06-23}}</ref><ref>{{cite news|url = https://www.indiatvnews.com/telangana/hyderabad-telangana-cm-kcr-says-bharat-rashtra-samithi-will-form-government-at-centre-after-lok-sabha-elections-in-2024-2023-04-14-863566|title =Mission 2024: Telangana CM KCR exudes confidence of forming govt at Centre after Lok Sabha elections|access-date=2023-06-23}}</ref> Voter turnout of 65.67% has been recorded.<ref name="LS polls: Telangana records 66.3 per cent polling">{{cite news |last1=The Economic Times |title=LS polls: Telangana records 66.3 per cent polling |url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/news/elections/lok-sabha/telangana/ls-polls-telangana-records-66-3-per-cent-polling/articleshow/110124843.cms |access-date=15 May 2024 |date=14 May 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240515042335/https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/news/elections/lok-sabha/telangana/ls-polls-telangana-records-66-3-per-cent-polling/articleshow/110124843.cms |archive-date=15 May 2024}}</ref>

The [[Bharatiya Janata Party]] and the [[Indian National Congress]] performed strongly in the elections, winning 8 seats each. The remaining seat was won by the AIMIM. The [[Bharat Rashtra Samiti]], which had previously won 9 seats, was decimated and failed to win any seat.<ref>{{cite news |last1=The Hindu |first1= |date=4 June 2024 |title=Telangana Election Results 2024 Highlights: BJP, Congress win 8 seats each; MIM bags 1 |url=https://www.thehindu.com/elections/lok-sabha/telangana-election-results-2024-live/article68214982.ece |archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20240604182250/https://www.thehindu.com/elections/lok-sabha/telangana-election-results-2024-live/article68214982.ece |archivedate=4 June 2024 |accessdate=4 June 2024 |language=en-IN}}</ref>
